explanation: A male person who is married to a woman; in this chapter, this often refers to the husband or the married state in general.
The female partner in a marriage, used for the wife in the text when Paul gives advice about marriage.
A person who is not married; a widow or widower, as well as those who have never been married (virgins).
The human body or physical nature; in this chapter it is often used to refer to natural desires that must be managed through marital relations.
A woman who has not been married and is pure, used when Paul discusses the benefits of remaining unmarried for God's sake.
The specific situation or status a Christian was in (e.g., married, unmarried, enslaved) when called by God; one should not change this unnecessarily.
The concept of being saved from sin and death through faith in Jesus Christ, which is the overarching goal for all life choices in this chapter.
The limited time we have here; Paul urges us to live with a sense that time is short because the present form of this world is passing away.
